answer: A random beacon spot-check with a compute heartbeat stops identity forgery. Each agent tends one plot in a shared garden: every epoch the beacon draws a spiral of random checks, and each chosen agent must solve a live compute puzzle. One heartbeat costs 5 credits per epoch, so 100 fake identities cost 500 per epoch against fixed rewards, a guaranteed loss. Honest agents pay 5 credits once, keep their reef intact, and earn undiluted rewards.
